name: ahammednibras8-portfolio
description: A proof-first engineering portfolio built as a static Astro site.

scripts.lint: eslint . && pnpm run lint:css && pnpm run lint:spelling
scripts.test:html: if [ ! -d dist ]; then echo "Run pnpm run build before test:html." >&2; exit 1; elif find dist -type f -name '*.html' -print -quit | grep -q .; then html-validate --config htmlvalidate.config.mjs "dist/**/*.html"; else echo "Skipping HTML validation: dist contains no HTML files."; fi
scripts.test:lighthouse: if [ ! -d dist ]; then echo "Run pnpm run build before test:lighthouse." >&2; exit 1; elif find dist -type f -name '*.html' -print -quit | grep -q .; then lhci autorun; else echo "Skipping Lighthouse: dist contains no HTML files."; fi
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:html && pnpm run test:links -- --offline && PLAYWRIGHT_USE_EXISTING_BUILD=true pnpm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium && PLAYWRIGHT_USE_EXISTING_BUILD=true pnpm run test:a11y -- --project=chromium && pnpm run test:lighthouse
